Chat.SelectionQuestion: Explain what these selected nodes do. Separate graph facts from inferred intent:
Chat.SelectionRequired: Select graph nodes first (up to 32 nodes per question).
Chat.SelectionAttached: Selection attached to the draft. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
Chat.SelectionChanged: The selected graph or nodes changed. Select them again before sending.
Chat.NodeNavigated: Moved to the referenced node. Your next message starts a new graph context.
Chat.NodeUnavailable: The referenced document, group or node is closed, deleted or unavailable.
